in_marathi.name: Sharval
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the Horses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharval हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharval is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva' which means 'king of the horses'. It is a strong and powerful name, evoking images of strength, courage, and leadership. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is often depicted riding a horse, and the name Sharval is believed to be a reflection of his power and majesty.
